seeds.vh-6-0-0-0: By the silt-choked river quay, Master Vane hawks rusted scrap iron while the gray flood laps at his boots.
seeds.vh-6-0-0-1: Under the dripping eaves of the copper-smiths' alley, an old woman named Marrow sells salted eel and warnings about the rising tide.
seeds.vh-6-0-0-2: At the sluice-gate lockhouse, a weary lock-keeper named Hobb argues with barge-haulers about tolls on the muddy current.
seeds.vh-6-0-0-3: Near the sunken timber wharf, young apprentices trade gossip about the foundry's dwindling tin stores while hauling drenched hemp.
seeds.vh-6-0-1-0: Past the salt-crusted crane-posts, a rope-seller named Gault curses the damp air that rots his finest hemp cables.
seeds.vh-6-0-1-1: Within the shadowed arch of the lower granary, a clerk named Orin weighs soggy grain bags against unpaid municipal debts.
seeds.vh-6-0-1-2: Because the frostbite scar on your knuckles proves your crossing, a cautious ferryman grants you immediate passage across the churning lock.
seeds.vh-6-0-1-3: Behind the leaning timber tallow-works, a tallow-boiler named Bram scrapes rancid mutton fat from copper vats.
seeds.vh-6-0-1-4: At the corner of the silt-choked fish market, a net-mender named Sula curses the eels that chewed her linen meshes.
seeds.vh-6-0-1-5: Beneath the creaking iron sign of the Drowned Ox tavern, a weary drover named Thrum tries to quiet his shivering packhorses.
seeds.vh-6-0-1-6: Beside the broken water-wheel of the lower mill, a miller named Corin shovels gray silt away from the swollen axle.
seeds.vh-6-0-1-7: Inside the damp brick toll-office, a clerk named Jora stamps manifests for barge-loads of wet peat.
seeds.vh-6-0-1-8: Near the soot-blackened charcoal sheds, a charcoal-burner named Kael loads damp sacks onto a creaking handcart.
seeds.vh-6-0-1-9: Along the weed-choked canal wall, a mudlark named Tish washes river silt from a pocketful of copper buttons.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-0: Within the dripping archway of the cooperage, a cooper named Bran hammers iron hoops onto swollen oak staves.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-1: Under the leaking canvas of the vegetable wharf, a merchant named Hestia inspects bruised cabbages ruined by the flood.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-2: Beside the blackened chimney of the potters' lane, a kiln-stoker named Dael feeds scrap wood into a spluttering fire.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-3: Near the rusted iron chain-locker, a wharfinger named Fenn tallies broken mooring rings lost to the winter surge.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-4: Because Biscuit knows the old mule-stalls behind the tannery, you slip past the toll-collector's guard without a glance.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-5: Beneath the sagging eaves of the wool-combers' loft, an artisan named Nyx washes fleece in greasy river water.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-6: Along the narrow alley behind the candle-dippers, an apprentice named Jory spills hot tallow onto the cobblestones.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-7: Near the weed-hung crane on the timber pier, a sawyer named Loran stacks waterlogged pine planks.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-8: Beside the crumbling stone buttress of the lower bridge, a mason named Krell chisels dry mortar into a wet crack.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-9: Within the shadowy recess of the sail-loft, a seamstress named Thalia patches heavy canvas torn by mountain gales.
seeds.vh-6-0-2-11: Behind the rusted iron gates of the salt warehouse, a guard named Bron inspects leaking sacks of gray crystals.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-0: Near the smoking chimney of the tinker's shack, a mender named Garreth hammers dents out of battered copper kettles.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-1: Under the dripping thatch of the boat-builder's shed, a shipwright named Hesketh caulks seams with boiling pitch.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-2: Beside the flooded steps of the water-gate, a watchman named Dorn blows a cold breath over his frosted brass horn.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-3: Within the murky gloom of the rag-picker's cellar, an old woman named Martha sorts damp woolens by moonlight.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-4: Along the slippery stone embankment of the lower basin, a net-weaver named Nuala mends torn hemp meshes.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-5: Because you owe nobody a copper, you stride past the snarling debt-collectors outside the guildhouse with an easy conscience.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-6: Near the smoking hearth of the charcoal-burners' shelter, a worker named Joram roasts dry chestnuts over embers.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-7: Beneath the leaning timber rafters of the grain hoist, a clerk named Orla counts moldy sacks of barley.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-8: Beside the rusted iron winch of the coal-quay, a laborer named Skiff greases dry gears with mutton grease.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-9: Within the damp stone alcove of the shrine, a pilgrim named Vesper leaves a dried mountain iris for safe travel.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-10: Along the muddy lane behind the tanneries, a hide-salter named Cadan scrapes salt from stiff ox pelts.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-11: Near the creaking wooden crane of the timber-yard, a loader named Tavis stacks soggy pine logs.
seeds.vh-6-0-3-12: Beside the blackened stones of the smiths' alley, an apprentice named Bram fans a dying charcoal brazier.
seeds.vh-6-0-4-0: Within the shadowed courtyard of the bell-founders' guild, a master named Morzan glares at empty tin bins.
seeds.vh-6-0-4-1: Under the leaking iron roof of the casting shed, a journeyman named Cael scrapes slag from a cold crucible.
seeds.vh-6-0-4-2: Beside the deep pit of the grand furnace, an old caster named Tormund stirs gray ash with an iron poker.
seeds.vh-6-0-4-3: Near the cracked stone wall of the mixing floor, a weigh-master named Sula checks empty bronze scales.
seeds.vh-6-0-4-4: Along the soot-stained corridor of the forge-masters' office, a clerk named Orin tallies unpaid municipal warrants.
seeds.vh-6-0-4-5: Behind the heavy iron doors of the cool-room, an apprentice named Jory guards the last remaining scrap of bell-metal.
seeds.vh-6-0-4-6: Near the smoking ventilation shaft of the lower foundry, a stoker named Fenn shovels wet slack into a hopper.
seeds.vh-6-0-4-7: Beside the flooded drainage trench of the casting floor, a laborer named Krell pumps stale water out with a wooden bilge-pole.
seeds.vh-6-0-5-0: At the threshold of the primary casting pit, Master Morzan demands to see your cracked bell-metal before opening the gate.
seeds.vh-6-0-5-1: Beneath the towering iron crane of the main furnace, an exhausted forge-master named Tormund inspects the heavy bronze Clapper on your back.
seeds.vh-6-0-5-2: Inside the soot-choked vestibule of the foundry, a nervous clerk named Orin blocks your path to check your guild permits.
seeds.vh-6-0-5-3: Beside the glowing brickwork of the grand hearth, a scarred master named Vane weighs the desperate terms of your arrival against the empty tin bins.
